The pirates of {wiki:Nargor} started mining crystals in a cursed cave, the {wiki:Crystal Gardens}, and strange things began to happen. The pirate {npc:One-Eyed Joe} asks you to destroy the evil crystal deep inside, using a banshee's petrified wail. You can repeat this task every day and you get a {item:Crystal Shard}, a random pirate accessory and the achievement Wail of the Banshee.
